evidence.title: Hackers Use Chinese AI Tool to Hit South Korean Banks, Exposing New Risk

occurrences.checkable_against: South Korean forensic investigation records

occurrences.subject: South Korean financial sector

occurrences.checkable_against: Affected banks’ breach-impact assessments

occurrences.checkable_against: South Korean National Police Agency breach investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: Hackers used a Chinese artificial-intelligence agent to attack South Korea’s biggest banks and steal the personal information of 68,000 people, officials said, marking one of the first such AI-powered intrusions into the global financial system.

occurrences.subject: South Korean financial sector
